notes: Source page states these styles apply to all LSB Industries brands. Style 1 (letter year via chart, week digits) is NOT shipped: its year letter decodes only via a chart image that cannot be read, and its week positions are ambiguous (character-count week 11 vs digit-count week 13 on the page example K111300076). Style 2 ships year-only: its year digits are stated in page text, while its month letter decodes only via a chart image and is held. No ClimateMaster data imported; no usesStylesOf.
